lk1st.note_it: Menu fastboot sullo schermo (cont-splash) con avvio normale, recovery, bootloader e spegnimento, tasti volume e accensione. Verificato su un RM-937 il 14/11/2026: menu, tasti, avvio di Android dal menu e riavvio normale.
lk1st.note_en: Fastboot menu on the screen (cont-splash) with normal boot, recovery, bootloader and power off, volume and power keys. Verified on an RM-937 on 2026-11-14: menu, keys, Android started from the menu and a normal restart.
lk1st.source: lumia-msm8974/lk2nd branch martini, 5650648a, built with DEBUG_FBCON=1 ENABLE_DISPLAY=1 LK2ND_DISPLAY=cont-splash MEMBASE=0x0FF00000

lk1st.note_it: Fastboot verificato su RM-937 il 01/11/2026. Senza schermo: lk1st non usa il display (ripiego).
lk1st.note_en: Fastboot verified on an RM-937 on 2026-11-01. No screen: this lk1st does not drive the display (fallback).
lk1st.source: lumia-msm8974/lk2nd branch bandit, c6967d7b built with MEMBASE=0x0FF00000

boot.note_it: Kernel 3.4 con init minimale: log su schermo e seriale USB 18d1:d00e. Solo in RAM, mai avviato.
boot.note_en: 3.4 kernel with a minimal init: log on screen and on USB serial 18d1:d00e. RAM only, never booted yet.

lk1st.note_it: Avviato su un RM-1045 dal 13/11/2026: menu fastboot sullo schermo (cont-splash), Android e TWRP partono da qui.
lk1st.note_en: Booted on an RM-1045 since 2026-11-13: fastboot menu on the screen (cont-splash); Android and TWRP start from here.
lk1st.source: lumia-msm8974/lk2nd branch martini, 5650648a, built with kit/scripts/build-lk1st.sh

lk1st.note_it: Mai avviato. Indirizzo del 1520 e dei port 930 che partono da Stage2: da provare solo se la variante 0x7CC00000 non arriva a fastboot.
lk1st.note_en: Never booted. The 1520's address, also used by the 930 ports that start from Stage2: try it only if the 0x7CC00000 build does not reach fastboot.
lk1st.source: lumia-msm8974/lk2nd branch martini, 5650648a, built with kit/scripts/build-lk1st.sh
